notes: Built from USAspending spending_by_award search responses (POST, archived with request body in raw/manifest.jsonl, source_id usaspending-post). Amount = USAspending 'Award Amount' (cumulative federal obligation, not a ceiling and not an announced figure); disbursed_usd = 'Total Outlays' when present. Dates = 'Base Obligation Date' (first obligation), else 'Start Date'. Search was recipient-name text on awarding agency = Department of Energy over 2007-10-01..2026-09-30 and one page of up to 50 rows per award-type group; awards with zero or negative net obligation are omitted. Recipient name variants not matched by the name search may be missing. Government record, basis=disclosed.
